prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Phoenix to fix my air conditioning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” HVAC company that’s right for every Phoenix homeowner — the best choice depends on your exact location, whether this is an emergency, the system make/model, your budget, and whether you want a quick repair or a replacement with a warranty. I can help you find the top options for your address, but first a few quick questions:

- Are you in the City of Phoenix or elsewhere in the Valley? (Zip code is fine.)
- Is this an emergency (no cooling right now) or a non-urgent repair?
- Is this for a home or a business?
- Do you know the make/model or age of the AC?

How to choose the best company — quick checklist
- License & insurance: Confirm the contractor is licensed in Arizona and carries liability insurance.
- Certifications & training: Look for NATE-certified technicians or manufacturer training.
- Local reputation: Check recent Google/Yelp/Angi/BBB reviews and ask for local references.
- Written estimate & pricing: Get at least 2–3 written quotes that break out parts, labor, and permits.
- Warranties: Ask about labor and parts warranties, and whether they honor manufacturer warranties.
- Permits & code compliance: Reputable companies pull required city/county permits and follow code.
- Availability & response time: For Phoenix summers, ask about same-day or emergency service.
- Energy/efficiency advice: For replacements, check SEER ratings, rebates, and load calculations (not just matching tonnage).

Questions to ask when you call
- Are you licensed and insured? Can you provide your license number?
- Are your technicians NATE-certified or factory-trained?
- Do you provide a written estimate and a flat-rate price?
- Will you pull permits and provide a final inspection?
- What are your labor and parts warranties?
- Can you provide 2–3 local customer references?

Red flags
- No license or insurance
- High-pressure sales to replace before diagnosing
- Only cash/no written contract
- Very lowball price with vague scope

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 3–5 well-rated HVAC companies near your zip code (tell me your zip)
- Draft a short message or script to send to those companies requesting a quote
- Help you compare estimates once you have them

Tell me your zip and whether it’s an emergency and I’ll give a tailored shortlist and a ready-to-send request for quotes.
